selection: Random autosomal ACGT windows in blocks absent from all previous prior training and evaluation windows; random fixed strand. Original 1024 baseline-training blocks are reused without refitting hyperparameters.

denoising.probability: Arithmetic mean of normalized ACGT probabilities across eight fixed random masks; centre always hidden. No fitted temperature or benchmark labels. The rate is the expected MASK fraction in the published 15%/80-10-10 objective, not the best observed density.

mask_density.metric: Mean single-query log loss across draws, then windows; distinct from ensemble log loss.

assay_followup: NTv3 650M pre/post, same fixed eight-draw readout on all Siraj substitutions; both orientations, same element-macro evaluation as existing native scores. No assay-based tuning.
scope: Fresh benchmark blocks, not pretraining-unseen genomes. All scoring conditions retained. The denoising ensemble is a separate label-free probability readout, not a joint sequence likelihood.
